panels.title: 00 - 服务健康 / Service Health
抓取目标在线 / Scrape Targets Up
panels.description: 在线 scrape 目标数量。低于目标总数时说明 Prometheus 已无法采集部分服务。

targets.expr: sum(up{service=~"$service"})
count(up{service=~"$service"})

panels.title: IBKR 服务在线 / IBKR Services Up
panels.description: 核心 IBKR 应用服务在线数。

targets.expr: sum(up{stack="ibkr", service=~"$service"})

panels.title: 监控组件在线 / Monitoring Services Up
panels.description: Prometheus/Grafana/node_exporter/飞书 relay 的 scrape 状态。

targets.expr: sum(up{stack="monitoring"})

panels.title: Gateway 已连接/就绪 / Gateway Connected & Ready
panels.description: Broker 连接和 ready 状态，任一为 0 都会影响交易请求。

targets.expr: max(ibkr_broker_connected{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})
max(ibkr_broker_ready{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})

panels.title: 01 - 入口 HTTP 请求 / Inbound HTTP Requests
入口 QPS by 服务/路由 / Inbound Request QPS
panels.description: QPS 用来看当前压力和被打挂趋势。

targets.expr: sum by (service, route, status_class) (rate(ibkr_http_server_requests_total{service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 入口 p95 延迟 / Inbound p95 Latency
panels.description: 入口请求 p95，和 QPS 一起判断拥塞。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, route) (rate(ibkr_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 入口处理中请求 / Inbound In-Flight
panels.description: 当前正在处理的入口请求数量。

targets.expr: sum by (service, route) (ibkr_http_server_requests_in_flight{service=~"$service"})

panels.title: 入口异常与 5xx QPS / Inbound Exceptions & 5xx
panels.description: 异常速率。报警使用比例+最小请求量，避免低流量误报。

targets.expr: sum by (service, route, exception_class) (rate(ibkr_http_server_exceptions_total{service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (service, route) (rate(ibkr_http_server_requests_total{service=~"$service", status_class="5xx"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 02 - 出站依赖请求 / Outbound HTTP Dependencies
出站 QPS by 依赖/路由 / Outbound Request QPS
panels.description: 服务访问 PocketBase、Grafana、外部接口等依赖的请求压力。

targets.expr: sum by (service, target_service, route, outcome) (rate(ibkr_http_client_requests_total{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 出站 p95 延迟 / Outbound p95 Latency
panels.description: 出站依赖延迟，定位 PocketBase/外部接口慢请求。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, target_service, route) (rate(ibkr_http_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 出站处理中请求 / Outbound In-Flight

targets.expr: sum by (service, target_service, route) (ibkr_http_client_requests_in_flight{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service"})

panels.title: 出站异常与错误 QPS / Outbound Exceptions & Errors

targets.expr: sum by (service, target_service, route, exception_class) (rate(ibkr_http_client_exceptions_total{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (service, target_service, route, status_class) (rate(ibkr_http_client_requests_total{service=~"$service", target_service=~"$target_service", outcome!="success"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 03 - Gateway Socket 与 IB API 连接 / Gateway Socket and IB API Connection
Gateway Socket 监听 / Gateway Socket Listening
panels.description: IB Gateway API socket 是否可连接。

targets.expr: max by (service, environment, host, port) (ibkr_gateway_socket_listening{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})

panels.title: Gateway 状态码 / Gateway Status Code

targets.expr: max by (service, environment) (ibkr_gateway_status_code{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})

panels.title: Gateway 服务运行 / Gateway Service Running

targets.expr: max by (service, environment) (ibkr_gateway_service_running{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})

panels.title: Broker 连接尝试 QPS / Broker Connect Attempts

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, result, reason_code) (rate(ibkr_broker_connect_attempts_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Broker 断连与 IB 错误 / Broker Disconnects & IB Errors

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, reason_code) (rate(ibkr_broker_disconnect_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (service, environment, client_role, ib_error_code, severity) (rate(ibkr_broker_error_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 04 - Broker 请求压力 / Broker Request Pressure
IB API 请求 QPS / IB API Request QPS
panels.description: IB API 请求速率，看 Gateway 被打挂前的压力。

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, request_kind, result) (rate(ibkr_broker_request_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: IB API 请求 p95 延迟 / IB API Request p95 Latency

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, request_kind) (rate(ibkr_broker_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: IB API Pending 请求 / IB API Pending Requests

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, request_kind) (ibkr_broker_pending_requests{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})

panels.title: IB 错误码统计 / IB Error Codes
panels.description: 当前时间范围内 IB 错误个数，用于看影响规模。

targets.expr: sum by (ib_error_code, request_kind, severity) (increase(ibkr_broker_error_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 05 - 历史数据与回补 / History and Backfill
历史事件 QPS / History Event QPS

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, source, interval, operation, result) (rate(ibkr_history_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 历史操作 p95 延迟 / History p95 Operation Latency

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, source, interval, operation) (rate(ibkr_history_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 历史活跃请求 / History Active Requests

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, source) (ibkr_history_active_requests{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})

panels.title: 历史行数吞吐 / History Rows Throughput

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, source, interval, operation) (rate(ibkr_history_rows_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 06 - 信号处理阶段 / Signal Processing Stages
信号阶段 QPS / Signal Stage QPS

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, stage, signal_source, result, reason_code) (rate(ibkr_signal_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 信号阶段 p95 延迟 / Signal Stage p95 Latency

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, stage, result) (rate(ibkr_signal_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 校验与提交结果个数 / Validation and Submission Counts

targets.expr: sum by (stage, signal_source, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_signal_events_total{stage=~"validation|order_submission|claim|mark_processed", service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 07 - 反向操作与订单追踪 / Reverse Actions and Order Tracker
反向操作 QPS / Reverse Action QPS

targets.expr: sum by (stage, signal_source, result, reason_code) (rate(ibkr_signal_events_total{stage=~"reverse_.*", service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 订单事件 QPS / Order Event QPS

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (rate(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 订单操作 p95 延迟 / Order Operation p95 Latency
panels.description: 订单追踪/轮询/提交相关操作延迟。右侧图例用于避免长 label 挤占图表。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, operation, result) (rate(ibkr_order_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 订单/反向结果个数 / Order and Reverse Counts

targets.expr: sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 08 - 主机与进程资源 / Host and Process Resource
CPU 使用率 / CPU Usage

targets.expr: 100 - (avg by(instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100)

panels.title: 内存使用率 / Memory Usage

targets.expr: (1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * 100

panels.title: 文件系统剩余 / Filesystem Free

targets.expr: 100 * node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay", mountpoint=~"/|/var|/opt"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay", mountpoint=~"/|/var|/opt"}

panels.title: Systemd 单元状态 / Systemd Unit State

targets.expr: node_systemd_unit_state{name=~"ibkr.*|prometheus.service|node-exporter.service|grafana-server.service|feishu-alert-relay.service|caddy.service", state="active"}

panels.title: 09 - 订单命令与保护单个数 / Order Commands and Protection Counts
订单命令个数 by 操作/类型 / Order Command Counts
panels.description: 下单、待执行/取消、调整止盈止损、追踪同步等用个数看影响规模；order_family_type 区分 entry/take_profit/stop_loss/bracket_oco 等角色。

targets.expr: sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"place_bracket|place_entry|place_take_profit|place_stop_loss|adjust_stop_loss|adjust_take_profit|cancel_order|cancel_take_profit|cancel_stop_loss|modify_manual|ibapi_place|ibapi_cancel|modify|cancel|tracker_update|tracker_poll|tracker_live_orders_fetch|execution_fill|pb_order_sync"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 保护单 TP/SL 与调整个数 / TP SL Modify Counts
panels.description: 专门看止盈、止损、调整止盈止损、取消等保护单相关操作的个数。

targets.expr: sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"place_take_profit|place_stop_loss|adjust_stop_loss|adjust_take_profit|cancel_take_profit|cancel_stop_loss|modify_manual|modify|cancel|ibapi_place|ibapi_cancel|pb_order_sync", order_family_type=~"entry|take_profit|stop_loss|bracket_oco|partial_harvest_bracket|unknown|mixed"}[$__range]))

panels.title: 最近 5m 订单失败个数 / Order Failure Counts in 5m
panels.description: 最近 5 分钟失败/未确认订单事件个数，用于报警和影响面判断。

targets.expr: sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", result!~"ok|synced|seen"}[5m]))

panels.title: 待执行/积压请求 / Pending and Backlog
panels.description: 待执行和处理中请求用于判断系统是否开始积压。

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, request_kind) (ibkr_broker_pending_requests{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"})
sum by (service, route) (ibkr_http_server_requests_in_flight{service=~"$service"})

panels.title: 10 - 全链路阶段耗时 / End-to-End Stage Latency
信号阶段 p95 耗时 / Signal Stage p95
panels.description: 从信号 claim、validation、order_submission、reverse 等阶段看卡点。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, stage, result) (rate(ibkr_signal_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 订单操作 p95 耗时 / Order Operation p95
panels.description: 下单、取消、修改、追踪同步等操作耗时，用于快速定位订单链路卡点。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, operation, result) (rate(ibkr_order_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Broker 请求 p95 耗时 / Broker Request p95

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, request_kind, result) (rate(ibkr_broker_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 历史/回补 p95 耗时 / History and Backfill p95

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, environment, source, interval, operation) (rate(ibkr_history_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 11 - 影响规模与报警辅助 / Impact Counts and Alert Context
最近 5m 入口请求/错误个数 / Inbound 5m Counts
panels.description: 个数用于判断影响规模；QPS 用于判断压力。

targets.expr: sum by (service, route, status_class) (increase(ibkr_http_server_requests_total{service=~"$service"}[5m]))
sum by (service, route, exception_class) (increase(ibkr_http_server_exceptions_total{service=~"$service"}[5m]))

panels.title: 最近 5m Broker/订单错误个数 / Broker and Order 5m Counts

targets.expr: sum by (service, environment, client_role, ib_error_code, severity) (increase(ibkr_broker_error_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment"}[5m]))
sum by (operation, order_family_type, result, reason_code) (increase(ibkr_order_events_total{service=~"$service", environment=~"$environment", result!="ok"}[5m]))

title: 量化监控 - 分阶段请求链路 / Quant Monitoring - Phased Request Flow
